Waning crescent moon, 16% illuminated, shot in Idaho on 2015/09/09 at 05:30 AM MDT. Captured with a Nikon D7000 DSLR at prime focus through a Celestron C90 Mak-Cass. ISO 100, 1/20" exposure time.

I cropped and centered the images with PIPP, stacked the best 100-ish frames in AviStack, applied wavelets in Registax, then balanced levels in Gimp.

Your comments and suggestions are welcome. I still feel like when I get to the wavelets step in Registax I don't know what the heck I'm doing, but I'm pretty happy with the result.

As a bonus, I took another series of 1" exposures at ISO 3200 to expose the portion of the moon in shadow. I think it looks pretty cool, too!
